problem_analysis:
Size: Small
Complexity Drivers:
- High network density at 163.2% indicates significant overlap and potential congestion across the 1,764 lanes.
- Low demand concentration with a Top-5 share of only 5.6% implies a highly distributed load profile.
- Absence of defined services (0) requires full route construction from scratch for all 47 ports.
Demand Concentration: low - The distributed demand profile necessitates a balanced allocation strategy rather than prioritizing a few high-volume corridors.
Decomposition Rationale: Partition the 47 ports into three geographic regions of approximately 15-16 ports each to manage the 1,764 lane interactions within computationally tractable sub-problems.

Latest row of each page on 2026-10-11 (page label 'F Oct 9'). The pages show weekday and month-day only; the year 2026 is inferred from the weekday (Friday 9 October is 2026) and the retrieval date. Only 5 of the 47 WorldSmall ports have an observation; every other rotation is priced at the reference (basis 'global_reference').
fuel_pricing.licence_note: Read from public Ship & Bunker price pages (full markets and downloads require login/subscription; no reuse licence is stated on the pages; https://shipandbunker.com/terms was not reviewed). Six individual dated figures are recorded here for audit and benchmark pinning; this is not a redistributable dataset. Check the provider's terms before sharing the file outside the project.

assumptions.basis: assumed (not in the canonical WorldSmall files): LINERLIB benchmark documentation gives a minimum port stay of 24 h, a minimum transshipment time of 48 h and a bunker cost of 600 USD/t. transfer_wait_days is the expected wait for a connecting weekly departure (half a week).
assumptions.sailing_speed: class designSpeed (only speed with a source consumption)
assumptions.transit_time_unit: TransitTime column read as days (unverified unit)

iteration_selection.reasoning: Deterministic multi-objective policy selected iteration 1 using active objective weights {'weekly_profit': 0.6, 'global_demand_weighted_coverage': 0.25, 'total_cost': 0.15} and Pareto analysis.
